WITH order_averages AS (
  SELECT order_id, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS average_quantity
  FROM Order_Items
  WHERE product_quantity IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY order_id
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS average_quantity
  FROM Order_Items
  WHERE product_quantity IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT oa.order_id,
       oa.average_quantity,
       oa.average_quantity - all_avg.average_quantity AS difference_from_overall
FROM order_averages AS oa
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS all_avg
WHERE all_avg.average_quantity IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference_from_overall DESC, difference_from_overall IS NULL ASC
LIMIT 10
